# Footer Section

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Footer Section

The footer of a website usually includes essential information such as copyright details, contact options, privacy policies, and links to social media.

![Design of the Footer Section](data:image/png;base64,)

The code is as follows:

```html
1 <footer class="footer">
2  <p class="footer-text">Made with <span class="heart">❤️</span> by Jane</p>
3  <div class="footer-logos">
4    <a href="https://github.com" target="_blank">
5      <img src="/images/learn-css/github-logo.png" alt="GitHub" />
6    </a>
7    <a href="https://linkedin.com" target="_blank">
8      <img src="/images/learn-css/linkedin-logo.png" alt="LinkedIn" />
9    </a>
10    <a href="mailto:example@gmail.com">
11      <img src="/images/learn-css/gmail-logo.png" alt="Gmail" />
12    </a>
13  </div>    
14</footer>
```

```css
1.footer {
2    background-color: #2c2e48;
3    text-align: center;
4    color: #ffffff;
5    display: flex;
6    justify-content: space-between;
7    align-items: center;
8    padding: 10px 40px;
9    /* Increased left and right padding */
10}
11
12.footer-text {
13    font-size: 16px;
14    margin: 0;
15}
16
17.heart {
18    color: red;
19}
20
21.footer-logos {
22    display: flex;
23    gap: 10px;
24    color: inherit;
25}
26
27.footer-logos img {
28    width: 20px;
29    height: 20px;
30}
```
